description: This file contains utility functions for rendering forms and client-side validation scripts related to the 'Settings' module in the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for generating JavaScript validation code and HTML forms for creating new records within the module.

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for validating form input fields related to email settings, including email format and required fields.

methods.name: get_new_record_form
methods.description: Constructs an HTML form for creating a new record in the Settings module, with dynamically generated fields based on database metadata.
